svg.title: Input tokens over a run
svg.desc: A plot. The x axis is the number of steps in the run, 0 to 40; the y axis is the total input tokens over the run, in thousands, 0 to 300. A solid curve for ReAct rises faster and faster, with dots at 10 steps (31,250), 20 steps (87,500) and 40 steps (275,000). A dashed line for plan-and-execute with one replan stays flat at 4,000 near the x axis. All inputs are chosen for this example.
